name: Keylogger + Payload
description: The Key Croc is an inline keyboard interceptor placed between a keyboard and computer that captures keystrokes and executes DuckyScript payloads triggered by specific keywords. It passively captures credentials, commands, and sensitive input, and can activate payloads when the user types a trigger string. It is one of the most operationally precise implants for targeted credential capture on a specific workstation.

blue.det: Inline device between keyboard and computer detectable by physical inspection; endpoint may alert on new HID device; captured credentials replayed from unusual location.
blue.cm: Physical inspection of workstations — check keyboard connections; endpoint monitoring for new HID devices; use wireless keyboards (eliminates inline intercept); MFA preventing credential replay.
